body:
So I had intentions of smoking Hydrangeas even with its cyanide compound when smoked... at the time it was worth a risk. I help my grandma landscape and one of her customers has several hydrangeas. I grabbed 1 leaf assuming when smoked it's like marijuana and doesn't need a large amount smoked.
Once I got home I packed a bowl of ripped up chunk of the leaf. I have no clue if it woulda been better to dry it because it didn't really smoke well. I smoked just 2 bowls in total for such a miniscule high it was clearly not the worth the risk of cyanide poison. All I really  got from it was a lil spaced out.
But after not being happy with the high I got I decided to smoke a few bowls of weed. I notice a way better high. I was playing a game at the time and was realy zoned in.
All in all hydrangea wasnt worth it..........dunno why I did.
